lines.text: David son of Jesse, anointed by the God of Jacob, gives these as his last words.
David says the prophet Nathan spoke through him, and that God's word was on his tongue.
The Rock of Israel says a ruler who rules with justice is like morning light at a cloudless dawn.
David says God made an everlasting covenant with him and will bring about his full salvation and every desire.
David says the worthless are like thorns raked aside, and anyone touching them needs reeds or a spear shaft.
